items.method: Cross-read the real-assets model leaders (crypto and industrial-metal scores), the bond model's high-yield-versus-investment-grade price-ratio direction, and the option-flow premium lean to establish whether risk appetite is broad across asset classes, then test that against the equity participation line from market-heatmap breadth and the dealer-gamma flip-versus-spot gap to judge whether equity participation is confirming or lagging the cross-asset risk-on signal.
items.note: The genuinely new feature this window is a risk-on signature that shows up everywhere except equity participation. Real assets are led by crypto — ETH-USD 76.3 and BTC-USD 73.2 both in uptrends — industrial copper (CPER) reads 63.8 with broad commodities firm (PDBC 62.6, DBC 62.4), the bond model reads the high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio strengthening across both aligned pairs, and option premium stays call-heavy at 1491 flagged contracts on a 0.67 call fraction. Yet market-heatmap breadth is only 58.1% of 134 constituents, still 1.9 points shy of the 60% broad-participation line, and SPY at 765.72 is pinned about 4.16 points below the 769.88 dealer flip in negative gamma with VIX 15.13. So credit, crypto and commodities are confirming appetite that the equity tape has not yet ratified through breadth. Watch breadth clearing the 60% line and a reclaim of the 769.88 flip as the confirming triggers; the constructive cross-asset read is invalidated on a daily close below 765.00 on SPY, which loses the 765 put wall in negative gamma and reopens downside toward the lower strikes.
items.title: Cross-asset risk appetite (crypto leadership, firm copper, strengthening HY/IG price ratio, call-heavy premium) is running ahead of equity breadth still stuck 1.9 points under the 60% line

inputs: sector-research-lab.into=XLE Leading, accel +4.28; out=XLF Weakening, accel +1.47; benchmark=SPY; sectors=11
real-assets-lab.USO=45.4 Mixed; mom21=-3.48; mom63=-5.54; mom126=66.53; energyEquityConfirmation=73.34
items.method: Compare the sector-rotation acceleration into energy (XLE) against the real-assets industrial-metal and broad-commodity scores to confirm the cyclical bid, then test the oil vehicle's own model score and short-horizon momentum to detect whether the underlying oil-price tape is confirming or diverging from the energy-equity leadership, and anchor the read's invalidation to the broad-tape benchmark level the rotation depends on.
items.note: The new divergence this window is inside the cyclical trade: sector rotation is moving into XLE (Leading, acceleration +4.28) as XLF weakens (Weakening, +1.47), and the real-assets model confirms the cyclical/metals side with copper (CPER) at 63.8 in an uptrend and broad commodities firm (PDBC 62.6, DBC 62.4). But the oil vehicle USO reads only 45.4 and Mixed, with 21-day momentum -3.48 and 63-day -5.54 even as its 126-day sits +66.53 — so the energy-equity bid (XLE Leading, and USO's own energy-equity confirmation score 73.3) is running ahead of the oil-price tape. This is an energy-equity-over-oil-price divergence: the cyclical rotation is confirmed across equities and metals while crude itself has not turned up on the near-term window. Watch USO reclaiming positive 21-day and 63-day momentum as the trigger that closes the divergence; because this is a constructive cyclical-rotation read expressed at the index level, it is invalidated on a daily close below 760.00 on SPY, which would break the broad-tape support the rotation is leaning on.
items.title: Energy-equity and industrial-metal rotation is confirming while the oil vehicle itself lags — XLE Leading and copper (CPER) firm, but USO reads only 45.4 with negative near-term momentum
